purpose: Support V28 opportunity slide marketplace comparison
slide_line: Uber, DoorDash and Booking.com bring organized supply to AI agents.
gap_line: Local providers still span disconnected quoting, scheduling and booking systems.
claim_boundary: Different depths of integration. No claim that all platforms complete every booking/payment inside every agent, and no universal absence-of-competition claim.

sources.finding: Official developer documentation describes agentic MCP ride booking and access to supply, pricing and trip lifecycle.
Official page describes CLI and corporate MCP ordering, including checkout, in limited beta.
May 20, 2026 announcement: ChatGPT app supports rental-car discovery and redirects to Booking.com to complete reservation.
Demand API supports integrated booking for eligible partners and supported travel services. This is separate from the ChatGPT app flow.

Markets commerce infrastructure for AI agents, including moving and home improvement. Supports avoiding a blanket claim that nothing exists. Marketing does not establish coverage or reliability for GoLocal's target pilot.

final_deck_use: Marketplace comparisons omitted from final slides following founder steering. Research preserved as context, not final pitch wording.
final_slide_close: A platform that closes the last two steps can earn a share of completed local-service bookings.
